items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: We didn't know Tony like me. Tony and Jilly would install Sturvey like piano plays... People like Tony better if he sang, you know. He sang.

ctx.x: Never. Did you know Tony Jackson?
Yeah. We didn't know Tony like me. Tony and Jilly would install Sturvey like piano plays, you know, single, you know. The two albums? Mm-hmm. People like Tony better if he sang, you know. He sang.
